description: The Department of Veterans Affairs (VA), Michael E. DeBakey VA Medical Center (MEDVAMC) in Houston, TX 77030 has a requirement for Non-Emergent, Wheelchair Transportation Services for Michael E. DeBakey VAMC, its associated Community-Based Outpatient Clinics (CBOCs), and Affiliated Healthcare Clinics. This acquisition is for a single award, Firm Fixed Price (FFP) contract not to exceed (NTE) 5 years.
